title: Perfect-source internal Hom commutes with derived ringed-topos pullback
statement:
Work with sites small relative to the module universe [def-weil-size-convention], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $u:(\mathscr T',R')\to(\mathscr T,R)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi with commutative structure rings [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Write $L=Lu^*$ for K-flat derived tensor pullback, with its canonical strong monoidal comparison [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Write $H_R(P,Q)=R\mathcal Hom_R(P,Q)$ and similarly for $R'$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $P\in D(R)$ be perfect, meaning locally represented by a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], and let $Q\in D(R)$ be arbitrary. The canonical comparison is a natural isomorphism in $D(R')$,
$$\alpha_{u;P,Q}:L H_R(P,Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{R'}(LP,LQ).$$
Precisely, let $\operatorname{ev}_{P,Q}:H_R(P,Q)\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}P\to Q$ be the evaluation, the counit of the derived tensor--internal-Hom adjunction $\operatorname{Hom}(U\otimes^{\mathbf L}V,W)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(U,R\mathcal Hom(V,W))$ [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Then $\alpha_{u;P,Q}$ is the morphism corresponding under this adjunction for $R'$ (with $U=L H_R(P,Q)$ and $V=LP$) to
$$L H_R(P,Q)\otimes_{R'}^{\mathbf L}LP\xrightarrow{t^{-1}}L(H_R(P,Q)\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}P)\xrightarrow{L(\operatorname{ev}_{P,Q})}LQ,$$
where $t$ is the tensor comparison of $L$. The comparison is natural contravariantly in $P$ and covariantly in $Q$. No flatness of $u$ or boundedness of $Q$ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08JH (lemma-Rhom-strictly-perfect) and 08H3 (lemma-strictly-perfect-pullback), applied locally to the perfect first variable; the evaluation-normalized ringed-topos form of the finite-projective pullback comparison.

proof.text: Use the closed symmetric monoidal structures of [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal] on both derived categories. For the categorical lemmas use the equivalent left-tensor adjunction, obtained by precomposing with symmetry. Put $D=H_R(P,R)$ and $e=\operatorname{ev}_{P,R}\circ\sigma_{P,D}:P\otimes D\to R$. By [lem-sfb-ringed-site-perfect-duality], the evaluation transpose $\phi_N:D\otimes N\to H_R(P,N)$ is invertible for every unbounded $N$. Its evaluation normalization is unchanged by exchanging tensor factors via symmetry.

source.place: Tag 08JJ, lemma-dual-perfect-complex, all-target evaluation isomorphism; Tag 0FPT, lemma-symmetric-monoidal-derived.

proof.text: Apply [lem-fix-closed-evaluation-dual-criterion] to these $e,\phi_N$. If $u_P:R\to H_R(P,P)$ is the transpose of the unitor, $c=\phi_P^{-1}u_P:R\to D\otimes P$ satisfies both triangle identities with $e$. Thus the exact dual pair required below exists globally; no global strictly perfect representative is required.

source.place: Tag 08JJ, lemma-dual-perfect-complex, categorical consequence of its canonical evaluation isomorphisms.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons], $L$ is symmetric strong monoidal, with tensorator $\mu=t^{-1}$. Apply [lem-fix-monoidal-dual-hom-comparison] to $G=L$, the dual pair of step 2, and arbitrary $Q$. Its specified left-adjunction comparison $\gamma:LH_R(P,Q)\to H_{R'}(LP,LQ)$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08JJ with the monoidal derived-pullback comparisons; categorical form of the perfect-source argument of cohomology.tex, Tag 0GM7, lemma-pullback-internal-hom (1).

proof.text: Write $A=H_R(P,Q)$. Convert the left-adjunction transpose defining $\gamma$ to the right-adjunction convention of the item. Its uncurried map is $L(\operatorname{ev}_{P,Q})\circ L(\sigma_{P,A})\circ\mu_{P,A}\circ\sigma_{LA,LP}$. Symmetric monoidality and $\sigma_{LP,LA}\circ\sigma_{LA,LP}=1$ reduce this to $L(\operatorname{ev}_{P,Q})\circ\mu_{A,P}$. Adjunction injectivity therefore gives $\gamma=\alpha_{u;P,Q}$, proving invertibility of the specified comparison.

source.place: Tag 0FPT, symmetry and closed adjunction; derived pullback symmetric monoidality. Evaluation normalization of the comparison.

proof.text: For $a:P_1\to P$ and $b:Q\to Q_1$, naturality of evaluation, the tensorator, and the adjunction gives $H_{R'}(La,Lb)\circ\alpha_{u;P,Q}=\alpha_{u;P_1,Q_1}\circ L(H_R(a,b))$: uncurry both sides, substitute the defining evaluation composite, and move $La,Lb$ through $\mu$ by its naturality and through evaluation by its adjunction naturality. This identity holds before any perfectness assumption. Restricting to perfect first variables yields the asserted natural isomorphism.

source.place: Derived pullback tensor-comparison naturality and closed-adjunction naturality; the defining evaluation transpose.
